_comment: Tier-2 for febio::heat#4, and a CORRECTION to its last clause. Omitting the 'zero fluid velocity' BC reproduces exactly as claimed: read SUCCESS, '------- failed to converge at time : 1', 0 completed steps, error termination, exit 1. But the claim's closing clause 'the logged temperature field is all zeros' is wrong on the shipped deck: the CSV holds one *Step = 0 block carrying the INITIAL CONDITION (300 everywhere). It is zeros only when the <Initial> block is removed as well, which the fixture executes as a third variant. So 'all zeros' is not a usable detection rule and the pitfall was amended. Positive control: the shipped heat_3d_bar / biphasic_3d_confined template, unmodified, which runs to normal termination — so the message is attributable to the single thing that was changed. Executed 2026-08-06 on FEBio 4.12.0.86045466d (source build, USE_MKL=OFF).
